method: Fresh isolated browser context. Public menus, real keyboard/mouse and read-only snapshots; no combat-state mutation or jump-ahead fixtures. Challenge qualification comes from an actual completed normal-S export. Full fifteen-level journey includes a paused export/import, secret arts, result/epilogue and a separate natural death/retry.
